hero.subtitle: Collaborative apartment search
hero.description: Stop losing apartment links in group chats. Bolyst gives you and your roommates a shared board to save, compare, and decide on your next home.

features.heading: Everything you need to decide,
features.subheading: No more scattered links, lost screenshots, or "which one was that again?" moments.

share.title: Share with your people
share.description: Invite roommates or your partner by email. Everyone can add listings, comment, tag, and favorite. All in one place.

map.title: Map view
map.description: See every listing on a map with pins for work, uni, or anywhere that matters. Distance calculated automatically.

compare.title: Compare side by side
compare.description: Select any listings and compare price, size, price per m², location, and tags in a clean table. Sort by any column.

howItWorks.heading: Up and running in under a minute

step1.title: Create a board
step1.description: Give it a name like "Berlin Q2" or "Stockholm summer" and invite your co-searchers.

step2.title: Paste a link
step2.description: Drop in a listing URL and Bolyst extracts the title, price, images, and location automatically.

step3.title: Compare & decide
step3.description: Tag, comment, favorite, and compare listings until you find the one.

pasteUrl.title: Paste any listing URL
pasteUrl.description: Works with any apartment site. Finn.no, Immobilienscout, Hemnet, Funda, you name it. We extract what we can and you fill in the rest.
pasteUrl.check: Title, price, images, and location auto-extracted

referencePoints.title: Reference points on the map
referencePoints.description: Pin your work, university, gym, or favorite coffee shop. Every listing shows the distance to your closest pin.
referencePoints.check: Distance to nearest pin on every card

trackProgress.title: Track your progress
trackProgress.description: Move listings through stages: New, Viewing, Applied, Accepted, or Rejected. Know exactly where each apartment stands at a glance.

tagsFavorites.title: Tags & favorites
tagsFavorites.description: Create custom tags per board like "balcony", "pet-friendly", or "close to metro" and filter or sort by them. Heart your favorites and see who else liked what.

cta.titleLine1: Your next home is out there.
cta.description: Free to use. Create a board in seconds. Invite whoever you're searching with.

footer.description: The shared workspace for apartment hunting. Save listings, compare options, and decide,

boards.subtitle: Your apartment search boards
boards.emptyDescription: A board is a shared space for saving and comparing apartments with your people.
